claim.value: One case need not explain all 19 late starts.
claim.scope: Limit on generalizing from the selected case to the full set of late starts.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly supplies the case-generalization limit and the count of late starts.

signal_basis.value: Repeated reduction tests under fixed conditions preserve lateness in a smaller configuration of the selected case, while specified further removals cease to reproduce lateness; inconsistent outcomes remain unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: Replay of one selected late case, using the same predeclared repetition rule for baseline and reduced configurations.

provenance.rationale: The bundle identifies the selected case and defined failure, and supplies fixed test conditions, repetition and uncertainty rules, and the observed reduction pattern.
This supported limitation requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Reproducing lateness through reductions of one selected case establishes a result confined to that case and test conditions. It does not establish that the same combination explains every late start, so the stated limit on generalization is licensed.
uncertainty: Whether the selected case actually shares an explanation with other late starts remains undetermined; the claim asserts only that generalization is not guaranteed.
